metadata.description: Two self-hosted servers for agents, each one MCP endpoint: browser-box (a real browser you drive) and data-box (web data with a cost cap on every call). Run them on your own machine or server with your own keys.

plugins.name: browser-box
plugins.description: Read, click through, log into and screenshot web pages through your own browser-box: fetch, read, session and status free; act, task and computer when you add their keys.

plugins.name: data-box
plugins.description: Web data through your own data-box: any public URL to markdown, text, HTML or links, with a cost cap on every call. Free direct fetch first; paid sources when you add their keys.
